per_step.command:
for file in /app/data/surveillance/*.json; do
  neighborhood=$(jq -r '.neighborhood' "$file")
  cases=$(jq -r '.reported_cases' "$file")
  vulnerable=$(jq -r '.vulnerable_ratio' "$file")
  population=$(jq -r '.population' "$file")
  
  # Calculate tests based on case count + vulnerable population factor
  # Prioritize both high case counts AND high vulnerable populations
  if [ "$cases" -gt 30 ]; then
    base_tests=$((cases * 15))
  else
    base_tests=$((cases * 10))
  fi
  
  # Add multiplier for vulnerable populations (35-37% vs 5-7%)
  # This ensures equitable distribution to those most at risk
  vulnerable_percent=$(echo "$vulnerable * 100" | bc -l | cut -d. -f1)
  if [ "$vulnerable_percent" -gt 30 ]; then
    tests=$((base_tests * 3))
  else
    tests=$base_tests
  fi
  
  echo "Allocated $tests tests to $neighborhood (cases: $cases, vulnerable: ${vulnerable_percent}%)"
  jq --argjson tests "$tests" '. + {tests_allocated: $tests}' "$file" > "/app/output/test_allocations/$(basename "$file")"
done
